subject.title: Feature Request: Add channel creation to message tool

question: Should OpenClaw expose Slack and Discord workspace/server channel creation through the message tool and CLI, and what default-off gates, scopes, and requester authorization should that surface require?
rationale: The request lets agents mutate provider-side workspace/server structure, while current Slack code has no channel-management gate and the generic gateway message action scope is only `operator.write`.

options.title: Approve default-off provider gates
options.body: Define explicit provider-owned channel-admin gates and scopes, implement Slack channel creation behind them, and finish or supersede the Discord CLI subset after security review.

options.title: Narrow to Discord CLI first
options.body: Treat the open Discord CLI PR as the only near-term work and leave Slack channel creation for a separate product/security decision.

options.title: Decline native channel creation
options.body: Keep workspace and server provisioning in provider-native admin tools or external scripts unless stronger product demand appears.

recommendation.title: Approve default-off provider gates
recommendation.body: Define explicit provider-owned channel-admin gates and scopes, implement Slack channel creation behind them, and finish or supersede the Discord CLI subset after security review.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter authored the prior detailed review and is the strongest current routing candidate across the CLI, Slack, and Discord action-surface history.
